comments.value:
Hi, we appreciate the sentiment and agree with this! I know that it may take longer than you hope for, but rest assured we are always working to improve our world making tools. 

Coincidentally, a good example of this is persistence, which just released to open beta yesterday. Persistence is going to have a huge impact on game worlds, allowing them to save data that can be used the next time you're in the world. If you want to stay up with the latest news in regards to VRChat game world creation, I'd recommend following the progress of persistence and the things people are making with it.

I understand that this might not be coming in the exact form that you're asking for, because it's not easy to use building blocks. That's because we tend to take an approach that is a bit more lower level than that, where we prioritize building a good interface for code at the base level. 

The great thing about doing it this way is that it allows anybody to make their own building block prefabs for all the incredibly specific use cases of VRChat. It also allows VRChat to publish official examples, which are prefabs that show you how to use our world-building tools like persistence.

That said, I can understand if you would want more building block prefabs made by VRChat itself. That's a great suggestion! But at the moment, this canny is a bit too broad in scope, so I'm going to close it. But rest assured that we are listening and always working to improve this.

details:
I have been seeing players complain lack of decent new games for vrchat but the problem it's very difficult for a person with little experience to make a game world, the game worlds play a big role in the community and having limited options has becoming more restrictive on what to choose for each year, making the game less desirable to come on to vrchat as the years go on, not only lot of players come on to vrchat for the game worlds, but they bring a lot of joy vrchat can't solely rely on a social experience we need more games to help build on the platform and show Vrchat is a lot of fun to play, games also help build new social experiences.

Please, I hope in the future of adding game making tools or least premade prefabs that can help a player get started on a new game and provide creative experiences to help the community branch out and find new ways to find joy in the community we love.
title: Vrchat greatly needs game making tools to help map makers make game worlds
